# 调调 Tutorials: Import, Offline Playback and Queues

> Start with one owned track, then check importing, metadata, offline copies, queues, sleep timers and lyric sources.

## App and version

- [调调: Personal Music Player for iPhone and iPad](https://allluckly.cn/en/apps/diaodiao/index.md): Organise and play your own music with 调调, including file imports, Wi-Fi transfers, offline listening, lyrics, queues and compatible personal music servers.
Version listed: 1.0; checked 2026-11-15; iOS 17.6+ / iPadOS 17.6+.
This is the catalog baseline, not a promise that every release has identical UI. Individual guides specify their own version context.

## Lessons in learning order

- [1. Prepare audio for 调调: check format, size and permission separately](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-prepare-owned-audio-format-size-drm/index.md): Prepare one recognisable, traceable small audio file before importing. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [2. Import a first file into 调调 and reopen it](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-first-files-import-and-reopen/index.md): Trace a file from provider selection through importing and actual playback. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [3. Check metadata in 调调: filename, title and artwork have different sources](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-metadata-title-artist-artwork-identity/index.md): Build a field-by-field comparison for one owned track instead of relying on names or artwork. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [4. Transfer music to 调调 over Wi-Fi using the displayed address](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-wifi-browser-transfer-local-network-check/index.md): Trace one small track from a computer browser to the device, beyond merely opening the upload page. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [5. Prepare offline listening in 调调: visible, imported and playable are different states](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-offline-imported-copy-network-control/index.md): Compare one imported track online, offline and after restoring connectivity. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [6. Check the upcoming queue in 调调 with three tracks](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-queue-next-track-order-small-set/index.md): Separate the current track from the upcoming queue and verify order by actual audio. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [7. Compare sequential, repeat and shuffle playback in 调调](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sequential-repeat-shuffle-observation/index.md): Hold three tracks fixed and change only the playback mode, comparing expectation with observation. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [8. Check the sleep timer in 调调 separately from a track ending](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-sleep-timer-duration-end-check/index.md): Choose an observable short timer and check its starting conditions, ending and playback recovery. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [9. Check background and lock-screen controls in 调调 one step at a time](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-background-lockscreen-pause-output-check/index.md): Start with foreground playback and observe backgrounding, locking and recovery separately. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
- [10. Read lyrics in 调调: separate source text, timing and missing words](https://allluckly.cn/en/guides/diaodiao-lyrics-source-timing-and-missing-text/index.md): Verify the track edition, then record available text, timing information and the actual lyric display. Originally published: 2026-11-15.
